The list covers flagship, mid-range and budget models that our readers asked about most in the past year. We left out foldables, which get their own comparison, and regional models that are not sold in the US.

Best phones of 2026: specs compared side by side

By Rafael Ito · Updated Oct. 1, 2026

When you buy through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission.

We pulled the launch specifications for fifteen of this year's most talked-about phones into one table. Prices are what each phone cost at launch in the US for its base storage tier; street prices are often lower, and deals change daily.

* Launch price in USD for the base storage tier. TBA = not yet announced. Weights are manufacturer figures; battery is rated (typical) capacity.

How we chose these phones

The list covers flagship, mid-range and budget models that our readers asked about most in the past year. We left out foldables, which get their own comparison, and regional models that are not sold in the US.

What the numbers don't tell you

Battery capacity is only half the story: the Kestrel Mini 3 has the smallest battery here at 3,200 mAh but lasted longer than several larger phones in our rundown tests thanks to its efficient chip and small screen. Weight differences of 10 to 20 grams are hard to notice in the hand; a case usually adds more.
